items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I was recording with little groups, with Dizzy, myself, Charlie Parker, Don Byas.

ctx.x: I don't remember. I'd have to go back and find out. Joe might tell you if you asked him, but I'd have to go back and find out. But Joe always could sing good, you know, even when he -- before he went into deLisa -- Mike deLisa's club. He -- a lot of guys sang at Mike deLisa's club, you know. A lot of -- I know before anybody knew Bird, he used to go out there and jam. He used to go out there and sit in when he first left Kansas City.
When you were with Earl's band in Chicago and doing all these things, you had not yet played in New York, is that right, or had you?
